r01-luis-rain.observed_description: Luis (navy T-shirt) holds a white mug inside by a big window and looks out at heavy rain running down the glass onto a grey wet street.

r02-ana-snow.observed_description: Ana in a navy winter coat, white knitted hat, white scarf and white mittens stands in a white park while big snowflakes fall, one hand held out.
r02-ana-snow.note: Usable: falling snow reads at 180 px; she is wearing a hat.
